records.name: lock
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production game UI icon on genuinely transparent background. Subject: a closed padlock with a rounded arch shackle and a small keyhole. The reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its warm polished golden metal, simple chunky silhouette, restrained bevel, amber edge shading and pale upper-left highlight. Single standalone symbol only, centered, front-facing, generous transparent margin. Readable at 24–32px. No enclosing button, square, tile, frame, badge, backing plate, text, ground shadow or decorative surround. Preserve transparent holes in the symbol.
